scenicChapters.title: Wunstorf fuel gate → Loccum abbey sight
scenicChapters.narrative: 30 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it. Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Rehburg hills → Mardorf lake road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 11 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: German Timber Frame Road Central Section
scenicChapters.narrative: For 82 km this is German Timber Frame Road Central Section, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

facts.v: German Timber Frame Road Central Section

hannover-lower-saxony-escapes-steinhuder.story: From Garbsen-Mitte it runs 519 km to Sarstedt; allow about 11 h 15 of riding. The stops in between: Wunstorf, Loccum abbey sight and Mardorf lake road. The climbs: Rehburg hills and Kyffhäuser serpentines. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
